description: This file defines the SiloConnectionFactory class responsible for creating and managing silo connections within Orleans runtime. It handles connection initialization, configuration, and connection establishment with silos, utilizing dependency injection for related services.

classes.name: SiloConnectionFactory
classes.description: A factory class for creating silo connections, managing connection setup and configuration within Orleans runtime.

methods.name: SiloConnectionFactory
methods.description: Constructor that initializes dependencies for the SiloConnectionFactory class.

methods.name: ConnectAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously establishes a connection to a specified silo address, with a check for dead silos.

methods.name: CreateConnection
methods.description: Creates a new silo connection with the provided address and context.

methods.name: ConfigureConnectionBuilder
methods.description: Configures the connection builder with silo-specific options.

methods.name: EnsureInitialized
methods.description: Initializes the internal services (MessageCenter, ConnectionManager, ISiloStatusOracle) once before use.
